title: Bookmark Freshness Review
summary: Review old bookmarks, check their health, and export a clean local archive.
user: Researchers and professionals with years of saved links
smallest_useful_product: A local browser extension that imports HTML bookmarks, checks status and canonical duplicates on demand, groups stale candidates, stores a purpose or browser-context note, and exports standard HTML.
constraints: Never transmit the archive by default
Throttle link checks and honor site limits
Clearly distinguish a failed request from a dead page
